gloss: to stretch in a row; to stand in a line; to attend

definitions.gloss: to stretch in a row; to extend in a line
definitions.explanation: Describes things arranged or extending continuously in a line or series, such as mountains, buildings, or objects.

definitions.gloss: to attend; to take part in
definitions.explanation: To participate in a formal event or gathering, often as a member or attendee. More formal than 参加する.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}が{連|つら}なっている。
{海岸|かいがん}に{沿|そ}ってホテルが{連|つら}なっている。
{遠|とお}くに{雪|ゆき}をかぶった{山々|やまやま}が{連|つら}なっているのが{見|み}えた。
examples.english: In the distance, I could see snow-capped mountains stretching in a row.

examples.japanese: {式典|しきてん}に{連|つら}なる。
{多|おお}くの{来賓|らいひん}が{祝|いわ}いの{席|せき}に{連|つら}なった。
{歴代|れきだい}の{社長|しゃちょう}の{名前|なまえ}がリストに{連|つら}なっている。
examples.english: The names of successive presidents are listed in a row.

notes:
{連|つら}なる is an intransitive godan verb. The transitive counterpart is {連|つら}ねる (to line up, to take along).

ASPECT (ている):
{連|つら}なっている describes a continuous state of being lined up or extending in a row. This is the most common form.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～が{連|つら}なる (something stretches in a row)
- ～に{連|つら}なる (to attend/join something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山|やま}が{連|つら}なる (mountains stretch in a row)
- {山脈|さんみゃく}が{連|つら}なる (a mountain range extends)
- {席|せき}に{連|つら}なる (to attend a gathering)
- {名|な}を{連|つら}ねる (to have one's name listed — transitive form)
